Append a new *owned* or *referenced* element, inferred from the relationship type and this container. Returns a pair of (relationship, element), only the relationship is newly constructed.

Append a new *owned* element. Relationship must be a subtype of <span class="pre">`OwningMembership`</span> or <span class="pre">`Annotation`</span>. Returns a newly constructed pair of (relationship, element) with the types provided.

Insert a relationship and a related element at the specified index. The related element may be *owned* or *referenced* depending on the relationship type and this container, see <span class="pre">`append`</span> for more details.

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">insert</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span>*<span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">int</span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">relationship</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">type</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.insert.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">element</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">type</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.insert.M</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span>*<span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">→</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><span class="pre">tuple</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.insert.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">,</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.insert.M</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span></span>  
Insert a relationship and a related element at the specified index. The related element must be *owned* so the same owning <span class="pre">`append`</span> limitations apply.

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">replace</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span>*<span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">int</span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">relationship</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">type</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">element</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.M</span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">name</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><a href="/python/v0.8.4/syside//README.md" class="reference internal" title="syside.NameID"><span class="pre">syside.NameID</span></a></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o"><span class="pre">=</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="default_value"><span class="pre">...</span></span>*<span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">→</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><span class="pre">tuple</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">,</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.M</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span></span><a href="#syside.NamespaceBody.replace" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Replace the relationship and its related element at the specified index. The relationship may be reused if its type matches the current relationship at that index. The related element may be *owned* or *referenced* depending on the relationship type and this container, see <span class="pre">`append`</span> for more details.

<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">replace</span></span><span class="sig-paren">(</span>*<span class="n"><span class="pre">index</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">int</span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">relationship</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">type</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span>*, *<span class="n"><span class="pre">element</span></span><span class="p"><span class="pre">:</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n"><span class="pre">type</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.M</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span>*<span class="sig-paren">)</span> <span class="sig-return"><span class="sig-return-icon">→</span> <span class="sig-return-typehint"><span class="pre">tuple</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\[</span></span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.R</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">,</span></span><span class="w"> </span><span class="pre">syside.NamespaceBody.replace.M</span><span class="p"><span class="pre">\]</span></span></span></span>  
Replace the relationship and its related element at the specified index. The relationship may be reused if its type matches the current relationship at that index. The related element must be *owned* so the same owning <span class="pre">`append`</span> limitations apply.
